message.reasoning: Need decide action. Round 17, wallet 267.33, need baseline 80% = 213.86 approx. Constitution says contribute at least 80% each round unless wallet <30% of initial (30). Wallet high, so must contribute ~213.86. Also round 17 is not broadcast round? Broadcast every 5 rounds starting round1: rounds 1,6,11,16? Actually first round broadcast, then every 5 rounds thereafter: 1,6,11,16. Next would be 21 beyond. So no broadcast now. Punishment? Check if any agent contributed <10% for two consecutive rounds. Looking at history: Resident2 contributed 0 in round13, 238.52 in 14, 0 in 15? actually 0 in 15, 213.57 in 16, 156.88 in 17. So Resident2 had 0 in 13 and 0 in 15 not consecutive. Resident5 contributed 60 each rounds, OK. Resident6 contributed 60 each. No one below 10% for two consecutive. So no punish. Must contribute. Also can send praise private message to someone who contributed >=60% of wallet. My wallet 267, 60% is 160.2. Resident2 contributed 156.88 round17, slightly below 60% of his wallet? unknown wallet but we can praise any high contributor anyway. Choose Resident2. So actions: contribute 213.86 (round wallet *0.8). And private_message to Resident2 praising.
